product_metadata.title: Nirvana Futons Matador Grey Queen Size Futon Cover, 60 Inch x 80 Inch - Proudly Made in USA
features: This futon cover is designed to fit 6" to 8" thick futon mattresses. Multi-sided zipper futon covers are easy to put on and remove, making cleaning a breeze.
QUALITY made in USA for exclusively for DCG Stores. Guaranteed against defects and workmanship for as long as you own the cover!

Your futon cover does not only protect your mattress and extend its life, it also offers countless decorating ideas for your home. Redesign and give any room a new look by just changing your cover. Matching pillows are also available.
Removable Cover Fabric Care Instructions: Machine washable with cold water and hang dry, no dryer. Material: 100% Cotton
This futon cover is made with fabric on all six sides. Be sure to properly measure your futon mattress to ensure proper fit. Not made for traditional bed mattresses or convertible sofas.
description: The printed Matador Grey covers are made right here in the USA. With shades of white, grey, red, pink, green, and teal, the fabric will compliment many room decor. All futon covers are made to order to provide the highest quality construction. Standard covers fit 6" - 8" futon mattress. 3 sided zipper-flap for easy removal (chair, loveseats and ottomans have 2-sided zipper). The cover totally encases the mattress similar to a duvet. Covers are serged and safety stitched for durability. Made in the U.S.A. Lifetime guarantee from defects on workmanship and materials. Fabric content: 100% Cotton Recommended Care: Machine washable with cold water and hang dry, no dryer
To ensure a proper fit, be sure to measure your futon mattress before ordering. The majority of returns are due to incorrect size ordering.

How to determine the correct size futon cover for your futon mattress: 1. Lay your futon mattress on a flat surface. 2. Measure the widest length and width. 3. Measure the height of the mattress at the highest point. Our covers will accommodate up to an 8" thick futon mattress. 4. Compare the length and width to the sizing chart below. Note: futon mattresses can expand or contract over time, therefore you may need to measure the footprint of the base to assist in determining the size needed.  28" x 54" - Chair 28" x 21" - Chair Ottoman 54" x 54" - Loveseat 54" x 21" - Loveseat Ottoman 39" x 75" - Twin 54" x 75" - Full 60" x 80" - Queen
